description: Replays transaction logs into dirty registry hives and saves clean copies.
usage: Replays registry transaction logs into dirty hives and saves clean copies. Use it before parsing hives collected live, so recent changes held only in the logs are not missed.
limitation: Only repairs hives that have transaction logs. Clean hives are not copied unless you add --ca.

parameters.label: Hive
parameters.description: File to process. Either this or -d is required.

parameters.label: Hive directory
parameters.description: Directory to recursively process. Either this or -f is required.

parameters.label: Output folder
parameters.description: Directory to save updated hives to. Only dirty hives with logs applied will end up in --out directory.

parameters.label: Always copy
parameters.description: Always copy hives to --out directory, even if they aren't dirty.

parameters.label: Compress names
parameters.description: Compress names for profile based hives.

parameters.label: Flat output
parameters.description: Do not recreate paths where the hives were located.
